reason: Paying in USDC on Solana means setting up a wallet and learning crypto just to get a 30 dollar translation done. I have a backlog, but I would rather pay a freelancer by card than deal with that.
objection: I do not want to deal with crypto or a wallet to pay for a small task, and it has not been audited and I would be putting money into something one person built.
